title: Binary search
task: Implement find_first(items, target) in search.py: items is sorted ascending and may contain duplicates; return the index of the first occurrence of target, or -1. Use binary search, so it is O(log n). Add tests.
follow_up: Requirement change: add find_last(items, target), the index of the last occurrence or -1, and count(items, target), built on the two; both must stay O(log n). Add tests.
